notes.title: ENIGMA: Version 1.3 Released
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26010749/a24332d028f5f4b2b43e4b9b52f0e468c2e16b31.png[/img]
Version 1.3 of [b]ENIGMA:[/b] is now live with a number of improvements.

Changes:
[list][*]Improved the spacing of menu items (requires starting a new game from main menu)[/list]
Fixes:
[list][*]Fixed a bug allowing you to try to load empty save slots
[*]Corrected the text in the background of empty save slots
[*]Fixed a bug that would in some scenes leave graphic artifacts on the left side of the screen if playing in full-screen mode[/list]

notes.title: ENIGMA: Is Here!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26010749/2a97b568cc497eae1cc46bffa950d7cd43ccd3ac.png[/img]
[b]ENIGMA:[/b] is now available on Steam! Struggle with Chester to unravel the mystery of the deadly epidemic before his time runs out in this riveting dark fantasy.

 Is there hope left in the world?

Here is what some early reviewers had to say about ENIGMA:
[list]“A truly rewarding - and at times disturbing - experience that makes every twist, turn and replay of the story well worth it.” 
[b]9.5/10[/b] – [b]Realm of Gaming[/b][/list]
[list]“With a few twist and turns, beautiful soundtrack, and equally charming artwork, it is a title that will captivate you until its end.” 
[b]Moonlitasteria[/b][/list]
